messages:
tara.m: Quick PSA — release note tidy before cutoff tomorrow 11:59pm PT. Please add changelog entries (one-line) for any user-facing changes and tag with a component. If you need help, ping me.

juan: Do we still want the 'component:' tag? I can add it in my PRs.

sophie: yes, component and a short one-sentence description please. Example format:
```
- component: cli | bump version to 1.2.3 (fixes race on startup)
```

alex: Will the release-bot pick up entries automatically from the CHANGELOG folder or from PR labels?

release-bot: The bot scans PRs merged into `main` with a `changelog/` file or the `release-note` label. Also respects `changelog: none` frontmatter.

devon: Heads up — branching note: if you're landing a backport to release-1.2, put the entry in `changelogs/1.2/` and mark `backport-owner: @your-handle` in the PR description.

juan: quick question: do we prefer present-tense verbs or past? "Fixes X" vs "Fixed X"?

tara.m: present tense please (keeps the changelog actionable). So "Fix race on startup".

sophie: also try to keep each entry <= 140 chars so it renders nicely in the release notes.

alex: pinging @tara.m — I have a PR that needs a tiny text polish. Can you add the changelog line? PR: https://git.redwood/infr/PR/452

tara.m: on it, will add a one-liner and tag component `runtime`.

release-bot: Reminder: changelog cutoff in 24 hours (2026-03-18 07:00 UTC). :alarm_clock:

devon: If you missed the cutoff, we can add a follow-up patch but it'll need approval from release leads. Try to avoid.

sophie: one more nit — please don't add internal-only notes (ops runbooks) to the public changelog; use the ops channel docs.

juan: done, added entry and component tag. thanks :thumbsup:

alex: added entry to `changelogs/next/` and marked backport. cc @devon

tara.m: thanks all — small housekeeping: use the template in `docs/release-notes.md` (link: https://git.redwood/docs/release-notes.md) and run `tools/changelog-lint` locally if you want faster feedback.

sophie: lgtm

devon: :shipit:
